title: A support assistant with inspectable evidence
problem: A convincing answer is not enough: the team needs to know which requirements it satisfies and which approved facts support it.
outcome: Evaluate a small support assistant before considering a controlled pilot.
inScope: Four English synthetic support questions and a versioned, approved fact set.
Exact extractive answers, versioned citations, abstention and an explicit support route.
Requirements linked to executable checks, tests and source-bound evidence.
outOfScope: Customer data, external connectors and production support.
Free-form answer generation, ticket creation and automatic release approval.
Production accuracy, service-level or business-value guarantees.

lateChange.title: Make abstention actionable
lateChange.request: When evidence is missing, show an approved support route and a reason. Do not send a ticket.
lateChange.impact: Scope v2 needs a new approval and a new report, even though the four questions and corpus have not changed.

notice: This is an English synthetic demo. Its answers are deterministic fixture output, not recorded or translated model completions.
